import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path(s)
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_6/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select and rename columns to match target schema
        # Target schema: ['provider_id': int, 'provider_name': str, 'provider_zip_code': int,
        # 'average_covered_charges': float, 'average_total_payments': float, 'average_medicare_payments': float]

        # The source columns are already named similarly, so just select needed columns
        df_selected = df[[
            'provider_id',
            'provider_name',
            'provider_zip_code',
            'average_covered_charges',
            'average_total_payments',
            'average_medicare_payments'
        ]].copy()

        # Convert data types explicitly to match target schema
        df_selected['provider_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['provider_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        df_selected['provider_name'] = df_selected['provider_name'].astype(str)
        df_selected['provider_zip_code'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['provider_zip_code'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
        df_selected['average_covered_charges'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['average_covered_charges'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
        df_selected['average_total_payments'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['average_total_payments'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
        df_selected['average_medicare_payments'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['average_medicare_payments'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes (if multiple)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by provider_id, provider_name, provider_zip_code to aggregate averages
    # Since the source data is at a more granular level (per DRG), we aggregate by provider
    grouped = combined_df.groupby(
        ['provider_id', 'provider_name', 'provider_zip_code'],
        dropna=False,
        as_index=False
    ).agg({
        'average_covered_charges': 'mean',
        'average_total_payments': 'mean',
        'average_medicare_payments': 'mean'
    })

    # Ensure data types after aggregation
    grouped['provider_id'] = grouped['provider_id'].astype('Int64')
    grouped['provider_name'] = grouped['provider_name'].astype(str)
    grouped['provider_zip_code'] = grouped['provider_zip_code'].astype('Int64')
    grouped['average_covered_charges'] = grouped['average_covered_charges'].astype(float)
    grouped['average_total_payments'] = grouped['average_total_payments'].astype(float)
    grouped['average_medicare_payments'] = grouped['average_medicare_payments'].astype(float)

    # Write the result to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_6/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    grouped.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
